Quarry Ridge Logistics LLC
Job Description Document
Employee: Morgan Ashby-Vale
Date of Birth: 02/17/1981
Date of Record: 03/11/2025
Author: Human Resources, Quarry Ridge Logistics LLC

Position: Order Picker
Department: Warehouse Operations
Reports To: Shift Lead Rosalind Mbeki-Farrow
Effective Date: 08/02/2021

Summary:
The Order Picker is responsible for efficiently fulfilling customer orders within the facility.
This role requires attention to detail and adherence to safety protocols during all operations.

Essential Duties:
Picking orders from racks and floor pallets.
Scanning items accurately upon retrieval.
Loading carts and staging completed orders for shipment.
Moving picked items to carts and staging lanes.

Physical Demands:
The employee must stand and walk the full shift.
The role requires frequent bending and reaching to access inventory.
Lift up to 50 pounds repeatedly during the shift.
Must maintain safe lifting practices at all times.

Work Schedule:
Standard shift is 8 hours, Monday through Friday.
Overtime may be required based on operational needs.

Note:
This job description reflects the duties assigned to Morgan Ashby-Vale as of 03/11/2025.
